tasks.description: Zero-resource correction of the immediately preceding S-BACKUP422 diagnostic. The v0 diagnostic completed but used ROOT.parent in the execution mirror and therefore reported supervisor backup_status/backup_index/receipts as missing even though canonical supervisor state lives at /data/openai-agent/state. This v0b task reads the canonical supervisor state path explicitly, still without secrets and without importing MPC/controller code, simulations, training/refits, validation64, or sealed/final tests. It records sanitized backup_status, backup receipts, backup index coverage for S-TC2H8-required artifacts, staging status, public GitHub release asset metadata, current git status, and a concrete next backup repair/request. This is operational metadata only and cannot establish vehicle control performance or scientific acceptance.
